title: Register Business Central On-Premises in Microsoft Entra ID

facts.text: On-premises Business Central needs a Microsoft Entra tenant with at least one user to enable service integrations.
Web client and OData/SOAP endpoints must be secured with valid production certificates and exposed via HTTPS.
You need an Azure portal account with Application Developer role to register applications in Microsoft Entra ID.
Sign in to Microsoft Entra admin center and register a Business Central application specifying name, account types, and redirect URI.
Create a client secret for the registered application and copy the secret value immediately as it becomes inaccessible later.
Grant delegated permissions to access required service APIs like Power BI, Exchange, or SharePoint depending on your needs.
In Business Central, run Assisted Setup for Microsoft Entra accounts and enter the redirect URL, application ID, and client secret.
Business Central online is automatically configured; manual Entra registration applies only to on-premises deployments.
